title: Page 5
lines: 「谢谢老板。」如斯拿起杯子浅嚐一小口。
奶茶非常香浓，不是一般即溶包的那种，是细心熬煮红茶后，加入品质很好的鲜奶才能有的味道。
她抿了一下唇，放下看起来并不便宜的瓷杯。
「好喝吗？」Chris随即问道。
「很香。」如斯称赞道。
「吴卫然。」他突然吐出一个人名。
她困惑地看着他，不解他没事干么提起那个背叛者的名字……等等！老板怎么知道吴卫然这个名字，难道他就是本人？
不可能吧……
两张不太一样的脸逐渐在她眼前合为同一张脸。
「如斯，好久不见。」吴卫然脸上依旧是那抹淡淡的浅笑，唯独眼神变了，变得专注、直接和炽热。
如斯僵在椅子上，什么话都说不出来，回想起自己刚才说了什么，她一颗心都冷了—
自从被一个王八蛋背叛后，我就不喝奶茶了。
「国中到现在快十五年了，都说女大十八变，男人也不例外，难怪你认不出我，刚才开会听到你的名字，第一时间我也愣住了，看着你说话的样子，才慢慢与你小时候的样子重叠在一起，确认你就是我以前认识的孙如斯。」吴卫然刻意放慢说话速度，让她有时间能够反应过来。
如斯没想到天真无知的国中时期谈的一场恋爱，不仅祸害了当时的自己，余毒还残存至今，加害了现在的自己。
「我是吴卫然，你想起我了吗？」他不想催她，但又期待两人相认，不过也有些担心她仍会因为当年的事而怪他。
她终于反应过来了，首先强调道：「我刚刚不是故意要骂你王八蛋。」同时她在心里告诉自己，那件事只可以伤害她一次，不能再影响她的人生第二次！
「谢谢你还记得我。」吴卫然欣慰一笑。
「老板，我对你有绝对的尊重，我刚才说王八蛋不是骂你，也绝对不是针对现在的你，是骂国中时代的你，这样说好像也不对……」如斯想把话解释清楚，却发现越解释越糟。
「国中时我对你做出那种事，确实是我不对。」这点他很有自知之明，且见她着急解释，他并没有丝毫被冒犯的感觉，反而对她感到更愧疚。
「所以我不用辞职谢罪？」她目前只想确认这一点。
「哈哈，如斯，有你在身边，我总能感觉很放松。」吴卫然有一瞬间的错觉，彷佛自己回到无忧无虑的国中时期。
那时候他身上没有过多的家族压力，还能谈一场不带任何目的的纯粹恋爱，方才他想着，如果没有发生那件事，他们现在是否还会在一起？或者，老天让他们在此时此刻相遇，就是为了给他机会，弥补自己当初犯下的错。
「很高兴听到老板这样说。」她表面上故作镇定，心里却莫名感到紧张，她真的没有心理准备再遇到他。
吴卫然的笑意一敛，认真的注视着她每一个细微的表情变化。「你是故意的吗？」
「故意什么？」如斯一愣。
「一直喊我老板。」他好看的唇扯出一抹淡淡的苦笑。
「你确实是我老板。」两人的身分不是很清楚吗？要不然要她怎么喊？「你不是吗？」
一句轻轻的反问，堵得吴卫然哑口无言。
跟国中时候的如斯相比，现在的她嘴巴厉害多了，人也变得干练直接，以前的她像团无害柔软的棉花糖，看起来浪漫，吃起来香甜，现在像穿上金钟罩，保护了自己，隔绝了他人。
脱掉这层金钟罩，她还是原本的她吗？他还能接触到当初的那个她吗？
「如果我不是老板，你大概不想跟王八蛋说话吧？」吴卫然看着她清澈果断的眼神，扯唇淡笑。
「老板，你悟性很高啊。」如斯正在小心拿捏分寸，试着找出面对他时应该用什么态度最合适。
他既是自己国中时期的初恋男友，也是她现任的老板，他已经直接把话点明，她也不好死守着老板和下属的单纯关系，必须在纯粹公事和往日关系之间拉出一条巧妙的平衡线。
「如斯，当年的事我跟你道歉。」吴卫然专注的看着她，把欠了几十年的一句话说出口，「对不起。」
「好，我接受你的道歉，这件事到此为止，以后我们就是纯粹老板和员工的关系。」如斯答应得很干脆，不希望过去影响到现在。
「上班时间，我们是老板和员工的关系。」他反倒无法做到像她那么干净俐落。「下班后，我们还能是朋友吗？」
「如果我说不行，你大概会说我根本没原谅你，对吧？」
她很清楚，他非常懂得在任何条件环境下，为自己争取最大利益，而且几乎没有失手过。
「你很了解我。」吴卫然低头笑了。
「一切老板说了算。」她站起身，想尽早离开这里和他，好好厘清自己的思绪。「如果没别的事，我先下去忙。」
在踏进这间办公室之前，她以为自己要面对的是笑面虎老板，没想到短短十几分钟内，情况完全翻盘。
「如斯。」见她迫不及待想离开，吴卫然忍不住开口喊住她。
她转过头看向他。「嗯？」
吴卫然定定的看着她两秒钟后，「很高兴和你重逢。」
如斯笑了笑，没有多说什么，转身走出了这间宽敞明亮的办公室。
刚才送奶茶进去且精心打扮的秘书立刻走到她身边，小小声的询问，「你还好吗？」
「很好啊。」如斯客套地笑着。「奶茶很好喝，谢谢。」
「老板很喜欢喝热奶茶，每天至少要喝一杯，我还特地去学怎么泡，后来老板只喝我煮的奶茶。」秘书骄傲地微抬起下巴。
「难怪……」难怪他随口一点，就能喝到现煮的奶茶，还不是从外面买来或简易型奶茶。
「老板从不和人一起喝奶茶，今天是唯一的例外。」秘书探询的眼神像两只黑色爪子探向如斯。
「老板今天好像有点反常喔？」如斯顺着对方的话打哈哈，「老板要我整理不少资料，他急着要看，我先下去忙。」
顺利溜下楼后，这天如斯忙得昏天暗地，主要工作内容不是新任老板丢来的功课，事实上吴卫然要她准备的东西，昨天她就搞定了，一天大部分时间她都在指导下属如何准备明天的报告和提案。
下班前她才找到几分钟空档，点开于舞能昨天半夜传来的相亲心得报告，内容惨不忍睹。
于舞能最后用四个字做总结—凌迟处死。
既然都凌迟处死了，如斯也只能回她—相亲尚未成功，同志仍须努力。
晚上如斯准备上床睡觉前，又收到于舞能的新讯息，内容是她星期六中午要去相亲。
这次对方是个很优秀的医生，为了避免凌迟处死事件重演，于舞能要求对方找一名男性友人相伴，而她也会找一名女性友人相陪，把相亲活动搞成假日娱乐活动，尽量降低没话聊又太尴尬的风险。
两人传了半小时的讯息，最后敲定时间和地点。
据说对方是很有大爱的医生，曾经加入无国界医师之类的组织，所以于舞能推敲对方可能比较喜欢干净简单的女人，于是她特地要求同行如斯穿一身名牌过去，用如斯的过度华丽衬托自己简单素雅的形象。
订好闹钟，抛开手机快要入睡前一秒，如斯的脑中闪过吴卫然的脸，不过有点模糊。
接着，国中时期的吴卫然慢慢出现在她脑海，徘徊不去。
content_en:
"Thank you, boss." He picked up the cup and took a sip.
The milk tea is very fragrant. It is not the kind that comes in ordinary instant packets. It has the taste that can only be obtained after carefully brewing black tea and adding high-quality fresh milk.
She pursed her lips and put down the expensive-looking porcelain cup.
"Does it taste good?" Chris asked immediately.
"It smells good." He praised it.
"Wu Weiran." He suddenly spit out a name.
She looked at him in confusion, wondering why he mentioned the betrayer's name when he had nothing to do... Wait! How does the boss know the name Wu Weiran? Is he himself?
Impossible...
"You..."
Two different faces gradually merged into one face before her eyes.
"So, long time no see." Wu Weiran still had that faint smile on his face, but his eyes changed, becoming focused, direct and fiery.
She was so frozen in her chair that she couldn't say anything. When she recalled what she had just said, her heart became cold -
Ever since I was betrayed by a bastard, I stopped drinking milk tea.
"It's been almost fifteen years since I was in junior high school. It's said that women have changed a lot, and men are no exception. No wonder you can't recognize me. When I heard your name in the meeting just now, I was stunned for the first time. Looking at the way you spoke, it slowly overlapped with your appearance as a child, confirming that you are the Sun Rusi I knew before." Wu Weiran deliberately slowed down his speaking speed to give her time to react.
Unexpectedly, a love affair that I had when I was innocent and ignorant in junior high school not only harmed me at that time, but the remnants of it still remain to this day, harming me now.
"I'm Wu Weiran, have you remembered me?" He didn't want to rush her, but he looked forward to the two of them getting to know each other, but he was also a little worried that she would still blame him for what happened back then.
She finally reacted and first emphasized: "I didn't mean to call you a bastard just now." At the same time, she told herself in her heart that that incident could only hurt her once and could not affect her life a second time!
"Thank you for remembering me." Wu Weiran smiled happily.
"Boss, I have absolute respect for you. When I said bastard just now, I wasn't scolding you, and it definitely wasn't directed at you now, but at you when you were in junior high school. It doesn't seem right to say that..." Rusi wanted to explain clearly, but found that the more he explained, the worse he got.
"I did something like that to you when I was in junior high school. It was definitely my fault." He knew this very well. Seeing her eager to explain, he didn't feel offended at all. Instead, he felt even more guilty towards her.
"So I don't have to resign and apologize?" She just wants to confirm this at the moment.
"Haha, like this, I always feel relaxed when you are by my side." Wu Weiran had a momentary illusion, as if he had returned to his carefree junior high school days.
At that time, there was no excessive family pressure on him, and he could still have a pure love without any purpose. Just now he was thinking, if that incident had not happened, would they still be together now? Or, God allowed them to meet at this moment just to give him a chance to make up for the mistakes he made in the first place.
"I'm glad to hear the boss say that." She pretended to be calm on the surface, but she felt inexplicably nervous in her heart. She was really not mentally prepared to meet him again.
Wu Weiran's smile faded, and he carefully watched every subtle change in her expression. "Did you do it on purpose?"
"What's the purpose?" He was stunned.
"Keep calling me boss." A faint wry smile appeared on his pretty lips.
"You are indeed my boss." Isn't the identity of the two of them very clear? Otherwise, how could she shout? "Aren't you?"
A gentle rhetorical question left Wu Weiran speechless.
Compared with how she was in junior high school, she is now much more talkative and capable and direct. In the past, she was like a harmless soft marshmallow that looked romantic and tasted sweet. Now she is like wearing a golden bell to protect herself and isolate herself from others.
After taking off this golden bell, is she still the same person? Can he still get in touch with the original her?
"If I weren't the boss, you probably wouldn't want to talk to the bastard, right?" Wu Weiran looked at her clear and decisive eyes and smiled lightly.
"Boss, you are very enlightened." So he was carefully trying to figure out the most appropriate attitude to use when facing him.
He was both her first boyfriend in middle school and her current boss. He had made it clear directly that she could not stick to the simple relationship between her boss and her subordinates. She had to strike a delicate balance between pure business and past relationships.
"So, I apologize to you for what happened back then." Wu Weiran looked at her intently and said the words he had owed for decades, "I'm sorry."
"Okay, I accept your apology. This matter ends here. From now on, our relationship will be purely a boss and employee relationship." He agreed simply, not wanting the past to affect the present.
"During working hours, our relationship is between boss and employee." On the contrary, he could not be as neat and tidy as her. "Can we still be friends after get off work?"
"If I say no, you'll probably say I haven't forgiven you at all, right?"
She knew very well that he knew how to fight for the best interests for himself under any conditions and circumstances, and he almost never failed.
"You know me very well." Wu Weiran lowered his head and smiled.
"The boss has the final say." She stood up, wanting to leave here and him as soon as possible to clarify her thoughts. "If there's nothing else, I'll go down and do some work first."
Before she stepped into this office, she thought she was going to face a smiling boss. Unexpectedly, in just ten minutes, the situation completely turned around.
"That's it." Seeing that she couldn't wait to leave, Wu Weiran couldn't help but call her to stop her.
She turned to look at him. "Um?"
Wu Weiran looked at her steadily for two seconds and said, "It's a pleasure to meet you again."
He smiled like this, turned around and walked out of this spacious and bright office without saying anything else.
The well-dressed secretary who had just delivered milk tea immediately walked to her side and asked in a low voice, "Are you okay?"
"Very good." He smiled politely. "The milk tea is delicious, thank you."
"The boss likes to drink hot milk tea very much. He drinks at least one cup every day. I even went to learn how to make it. Later, the boss only drank the milk tea I made." The secretary raised his chin slightly proudly.
"No wonder..." No wonder he can drink freshly brewed milk tea casually, not just milk tea bought from outside or simple milk tea.
"The boss never drinks milk tea with others, and today is the only exception." The secretary's inquiring eyes were like two black claws.
"Boss seems a little unusual today," he said, following the other person's words. "Boss wants me to sort out a lot of information. He's anxious to see it. I'll go down and do some work first."
After slipping downstairs smoothly, the day was so busy that the main work content was not the homework thrown by the new boss. In fact, she had completed what Wu Weiran asked her to prepare yesterday. She spent most of the day instructing her subordinates on how to prepare tomorrow's reports and proposals.
She only found a few minutes of free time before getting off work and clicked on the blind date experience report that Yu Wuneng had received at midnight yesterday. The content was horrific.
Yu Wuneng summed it up in four words - execution by Lingchi.
Since they were both executed in Ling Chi, this is all they can do to her - the blind date has not yet been successful, comrades still have to work hard.
Before going to bed at night, I received another new message from Yu Wu Neng, which said that she was going on a blind date at noon on Saturday.
This time the other party was an excellent doctor. In order to avoid the recurrence of the Lingchi execution incident, Yu Wuneng asked the other party to find a male friend to accompany him, and she would also find a female friend to accompany him, turning the blind date into a holiday entertainment activity to minimize the risk of having nothing to talk about and being too embarrassed.
The two exchanged messages for half an hour before finalizing the time and place.
It was said that the other party was a very caring doctor and had joined organizations such as Doctors Without Borders. Therefore, Yu Wuneng considered that the other party might prefer clean and simple women, so she specifically asked her colleague to wear a brand-name outfit like this to set off her simple and elegant image with such excessive gorgeousness.
After setting the alarm clock, putting down the phone and about to fall asleep, Wu Weiran's face flashed in his mind, but it was a little blurry.
Then, Wu Weiran from junior high school slowly appeared in her mind and lingered.
